This suggests that despite positive profit growth, the company may not be effectively utilizing its assets to generate returns for shareholders. In conclusion, while ICIL has shown some positive indicators such as strong market position within its range and consistent profit growth over the last decade, it is heavily discounted by both its P/E ratio relative to peers and its low ROE.
